t: 奥地利的玛丽亚·特蕾莎在击败对手神圣罗马皇帝查理七世后被加冕为波希米亚女王.
te: Maria Theresa of Austria is crowned Queen of Bohemia after defeating her rival, Charles VII, Holy Roman Emperor.
dz: 奥地利的玛丽亚·特蕾莎在击败对手神圣罗马皇帝查理七世后被加冕为波希米亚女王.
de: Maria Theresa of Austria is crowned Queen of Bohemia after defeating her rival, Charles VII, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: Jean-Pierre Christin 开发了摄氏度温标。
te: Jean-Pierre Christin develops the centigrade temperature scale.
dz: Jean-Pierre Christin 开发了摄氏度温标。
de: Jean-Pierre Christin develops the centigrade temperature scale.

t: 在德丁根之战中,乔治二世成为了最后一位统治英国君主来参加一场战斗.
te: In the Battle of Dettingen, George II becomes the last reigning British monarch to participate in a battle.
dz: 在德丁根之战中,乔治二世成为了最后一位统治英国君主来参加一场战斗.
de: In the Battle of Dettingen, George II becomes the last reigning British monarch to participate in a battle.

t: 奥博条约结束了1741–1743年的鲁索-瑞典战争.
te: The Treaty of Åbo ends the 1741–1743 Russo-Swedish War.
dz: 奥博条约结束了1741–1743年的鲁索-瑞典战争.
de: The Treaty of Åbo ends the 1741–1743 Russo-Swedish War.

t: 瑞典军队向赫尔辛基的俄国人投降,结束了战争并开始了"小怒".
te: The Swedish army surrenders to the Russians in Helsinki, ending the war and starting Lesser Wrath.
dz: 帽子之战:瑞典军队向赫尔辛基的俄国人投降,结束了战争并开始了"小怒".
de: The War of the Hats: The Swedish army surrenders to the Russians in Helsinki, ending the war and starting Lesser Wrath.

t: 大不列颠,奥地利和撒丁岛王国签署"蠕虫条约".
te: Great Britain, Austria and the Kingdom of Sardinia sign the Treaty of Worms.
dz: 大不列颠,奥地利和撒丁岛王国签署"蠕虫条约".
de: Great Britain, Austria and the Kingdom of Sardinia sign the Treaty of Worms.
